intent: New silhouettes; no previous monster used as an edit base

options.label: Stiltwalker
options.description: An unnervingly tall, thin mountain stalker: almost upright, extremely long stilt-like bent legs, a very narrow charcoal-blue torso with pale visible rib ridges, a thin long neck and a small smooth bone-pale oval head perched HIGH above its shoulders. Tiny black slit eyes and a crooked dark horizontal mouth; no hair, hood or mask. Very long slim arms hang almost to the ankles with three pale hook fingers. Ash-grey patches of tough wrinkled skin, minimal ragged tufts on elbows only. The silhouette is a narrow, towering inverted U with huge negative gaps, NOT a hunched ape. Sharp angular joints, predatory stillness, lean and disturbing rather than muscular. Native design box24 pixels wide by38 tall.
options.prompt:

The previous designs were rejected because they all looked like the existing hunched furry gorillas. Invent an unmistakably different creature silhouette. This is a dangerous fast omnivorous mountain predator, not a cute animal. It need not have a traditional gorilla Yeti body. Only TWO arms/front limbs and TWO legs/rear limbs; no extra arms, horns, antlers, red fur, skull-mask gorilla, or huge shaggy shoulders. Single full-body stalking/charging sprite, slightly elevated front three-quarter camera, facing down-right toward viewer. Chunky low-resolution pixel art with a dark one-pixel logical outline, restrained 12-16 colors, hard square pixel clusters, no gradients, bloom, antialiasing or fine painted strands. Preserve strong empty gaps between limbs. Make its defining shape legible in the specified native pixel box. Enlarge these coarse logical pixels cleanly. Entire character visible with generous transparent margins. Genuine transparent background; no ground, cast shadow, scenery, lettering, frames or other characters. Frightening but no gore.

options.label: Tuskbreaker
options.description: A low, immensely WIDE tusked snow brute, four-limbed and almost horizontal, like a monstrous alpine burrowing predator, NOT a gorilla or ordinary bear. Huge blunt slate-olive head pushed forward close to the snow, two enormous asymmetric yellowed tusks hook forward and outward on either side of the snout, making a wide crescent outline. Tiny deep red eyes under a low brow, immense compact forequarters with stony knuckles, very short powerful rear legs. Bristly umber-grey dorsal ridge, dark olive hide and ochre ice-crusted patches, small pale claw tips. Body proportions like a squat charging battering ram, very low heavy center of gravity. The intimidating tusks and broad horizontal form must stand out immediately. Native design box38 pixels wide by26 tall.

options.label: Ragjaw
options.description: A ragged split-jawed frost creature with a striking T-shaped silhouette: an enormous FLAT, WIDE, angular head that opens SIDEWAYS into two lateral jaw plates, almost like a crooked bear trap, above a thin upright neck and narrow torso. The two jaw halves spread left and right, showing a black horizontal inner rift with a narrow sickly amber glow and short icy teeth. Tiny deep-set ochre eyes; head plates are pale icy grey, not a skull mask and not horns. Slim dark teal-black hide, only sparse hanging charcoal fur strips around the lower torso, asymmetrical shoulders, one long sinewy claw arm and one shorter bent arm, two tense narrow legs. NO large gorilla back hump, NO round enormous mouth, NO shaggy mane. Its head is much wider than its lean body; threatening top-heavy angular form. Organic mountain horror, not a robot or mechanical trap. Native design box34 by34 pixels.
